name: Sea TV Network Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2004, Sea TV Network Ltd
 is a multi-system operator engaged in the business of cable TV network and cable 
operation[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) STVNL is one of the media & entertainment houses of Uttarpradesh & Uttrakhand, which owns a number of media establishments.
b) Through its subsidiary Sea News 
 Network Ltd, it runs a 24x7 news satellite 
 channel SEA NEWS UP/UK, primarily showing news in Uttar Pradesh & Uttarakhand. 
c) Through its subsidiary Jain Telemedia Services Ltd., the company operates another satellite channel focusing on Jainism, JINVANI.
d) It has been serving news and entertainment content for viewers of Agra through its Multi-System Operators service. 
e) It offers high-definition picture quality and digital sound quality through the Set-top-box provided by company. The STB has features such as HD channels, personal recorder play, MPEG-4 technology, parental lock control, pay-per channel, multi-language system, video-on-demand, customer care services, etc.

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -6.32% over past five years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 51.2% of their holding.
Company has high debtors of 176 days.
